name: CheXGenBench
intro: CheXGenBench是一个统一的评估框架，旨在全面评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度、隐私性和下游实用性，通过20多种定量指标标准化评估文本到图像生成模型。
org: The University of Edinburgh, Samsung AI Center
eval_feature: 评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度, 隐私性和下游实用性
build_method_en: based on existing datasets and manual annotation
eval_feature_en: evaluate fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images
intro_en: CheXGenBench is a unified evaluation framework designed to comprehensively assess the fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images, standardizing the evaluation of text-to-image generation models through over 20 quantitative metrics.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.10496. The paper designs CheXGenBench as a decoupled training and evaluation benchmark for chest X-ray text-to-image models. It selects 11 established and newer T2I architectures, trains them on MIMIC-CXR using enhanced LLaVA-Rad annotations instead of abbreviated report-derived prompts, and standardizes comparison through a 237,388-sample training split, 20 training epochs, full fine-tuning for smaller models, and LoRA rank 32 for larger models. The evaluation covers fidelity and mode coverage using RadDino FID/KID, BioViL-T image-text alignment, PRDC metrics, and pathology-conditional analysis; privacy and re-identification using pixel distance, RadDino latent distance, and a Siamese re-identification score; and downstream utility through synthetic-data image classification plus report generation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph, and F1 scores. The release step follows the paper by using the leading Sana 0.6B model with extended fine-tuning and HealthGPT filtering to produce SynthCheX-75K.
